title.narrative: Cabo Verde National System of Innovation Survey

description.narrative: Through its activities, outputs and outcomes, this UNIDO project will address the need for coherent evidence-based guidance and provision of technical support for policy making in the elaboration and implementation of science, technology and innovation (STI) for i ndustrial development in the Republic of Cabo Verde. This project is elaborated on the basis of UNIDO#s mandate and an analysis of policy documents of the Government of the Republic of Cabo Verde that deal with industrial development and the role of science, technology and innovation in the economy. The results of the project will be the increased efficiency and effectiveness of the national system of innovation (NSI). This will be achieved through an understanding of where actor linkages are weak as well as truncated and in further consequences strengthening them. This is in line with the post 2015 sustainable development goals (SDGs), namely SDG 9 which aims to build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization, and foster innovation. Furthermore, the Director General in the 42nd session of the Industrial Development Board on 25 November 2014 reinforced UNIDO#s commitment to strengthen our future global role in monitoring and reporting on the achievement of SDG 9. The overall project will culminate in an action plan
